name: pos-system
description: Multi-tenant POS with government-style PDF invoices (NestJS + React + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app/api install && npm --prefix app/web install && npm --prefix app/pdf-worker install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:cloud: npm --prefix app/web run build -- --outDir dist-cloudflare && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('app/web/dist-cloudflare/_redirects', { force: true })"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:pdf
scripts.test:integration: node qa/api-integration.cjs && node qa/api-integration.cjs --branches && node qa/api-integration.cjs --backup
scripts.typecheck: npm run test:web:typecheck && npm --prefix app/api exec -- tsc --noEmit -p app/api/tsconfig.build.json && npm --prefix app/pdf-worker exec -- tsc --noEmit -p app/pdf-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.cloudflare:validate: npm run build:cloud && npx --yes wrangler@4.168.0 deploy --dry-run --env staging && npx --yes wrangler@4.168.0 deploy --dry-run --env production
